reader_summary.overview: Adam Blitz is the CEO and Chief Investment Officer of Evanston Capital Management. Adam joined Evanston at its inception in 2002 and leads investment research and portfolio management. Previously, he worked in the Prime Brokerage area and Asset Management Division of Goldman Sachs and served as head trader at AQR.
